items.content_excerpt: $ONDS continued- 2. Will Q3 GAAP Earnings/EPS be higher (less negative) than Q2? Yes, GAAP net income and EPS are projected to be significantly higher (meaning a smaller net loss) in Q3 compared to Q2, primarily because the massive wave of non-cash and transitional expenses should subside. A direct look at the extreme operational drag that hit Q2 highlights why Q3 is positioned for a strong sequential rebound: • The Q2 Drag: In Q2 2026, Ondas reported a massive GAAP net loss of $89.7 million. However, $105.8 million of their total operating expenses were entirely non-cash expenses tied to that acquisition influx. This included an extraordinary $67.6 million to $69.1 million in stock-based compensation (largely due to the immediate vesting of equity awards for incoming executives and key teams) and $19.2 million from marking-to-market the fair value of contingent consideration liabilities. items.content_excerpt: $RKLB Wallops Update for Nov 7 At LC-3 the thrust structure that was delivered last week with Neutrons’ second stage is on the launch pad for umbilical and fluid checkout. This is the first time a piece of flight hardware is sitting on the launch pad. The structure still has the covering that protected it during shipping on. But the umbilicals are definitely connected to the launch pad. The second stage test stand now has some shielding covering some of the sides. Once testing with the thrush structure is complete the stand and the second stage will be placed on the pad for a static firing. Over at Pad 0A two new and taller lighting towers have been installed. The taller towers were needed to accommodate Antares 300 and Eclipse’s taller height than the Antares 200. No visible work is being done at LC-2.

items.title: $SHOP Nobody ever churned over a tier name. They churn when the money stops. The 2026 partner program update is being sold as clarity. Clear
items.content_excerpt: $SHOP Nobody ever churned over a tier name. They churn when the money stops. The 2026 partner program update is being sold as clarity. Clearer requirements, real-time tracking, nicer milestone bags. Fine. None of that touches the part that actually moves an agency P&L. The published program terms cap agency revenue share at four years. Shopify's own changelog shows the app-developer $1M exemption moved from annual to lifetime in April 2025. 15% is the US headline rate, and non-US developers pay more than that. What most people get wrong: they read a re-tiering as a compensation change. It isn't. It's a labelling change sitting on top of an unchanged economic structure. You can be promoted into a higher tier and still watch your year-five revenue on a 2022 client go to zero. The insight for anyone running the numbers: tiers are a recognition system, the rev-share clock is a cash system, and only one of those pays salaries.

items.title: $CRVS Abstract Analysis: 2. The most important findings A. Abnormal T-cell proliferation was reduced ALPS is characterized by accumulation o
items.content_excerpt: $CRVS Abstract Analysis: 2. The most important findings A. Abnormal T-cell proliferation was reduced ALPS is characterized by accumulation of double-negative T cells (DNTs), specifically CD3+, CD4−, CD8− cells. At baseline, Ki67 expression in DNTs was significantly higher than in normal controls. Baseline Ki67 positivity was 30%, 68%, and 45% in the three patients (p = 0.0002 versus normal controls). Patients 2 and 3 experienced reductions in circulating Ki67-positive DNTs of 20% and 75%, respectively. Ki67 is a marker of cellular proliferation. These reductions are consistent with soquelitinib suppressing abnormal proliferative activity in this cell population. The abstract demonstrates a reduction in proliferating DNTs, not necessarily elimination of the underlying genetically defective lymphocytes. It also reports no changes in total circulating CD4 or CD8 cells.

$SHOP Nobody ever churned over a tier name. They churn when the money stops. The 2026 partner program update is being sold as clarity. Clearer requirements, real-time tracking, nicer milestone bags. Fine. None of that touches the part that actually moves an agency P&L. The published program terms cap agency revenue share at four years. Shopify's own changelog shows the app-developer $1M exemption moved from annual to lifetime in April 2025. 15% is the US headline rate, and non-US developers pay more than that. What most people get wrong: they read a re-tiering as a compensation change. It isn't. It's a labelling change sitting on top of an unchanged economic structure. You can be promoted into a higher tier and still watch your year-five revenue on a 2022 client go to zero. The insight for anyone running the numbers: tiers are a recognition system, the rev-share clock is a cash system, and only one of those pays salaries.

$CRVS Abstract Analysis: 2. The most important findings A. Abnormal T-cell proliferation was reduced ALPS is characterized by accumulation of double-negative T cells (DNTs), specifically CD3+, CD4−, CD8− cells. At baseline, Ki67 expression in DNTs was significantly higher than in normal controls. Baseline Ki67 positivity was 30%, 68%, and 45% in the three patients (p = 0.0002 versus normal controls). Patients 2 and 3 experienced reductions in circulating Ki67-positive DNTs of 20% and 75%, respectively. Ki67 is a marker of cellular proliferation. These reductions are consistent with soquelitinib suppressing abnormal proliferative activity in this cell population. The abstract demonstrates a reduction in proliferating DNTs, not necessarily elimination of the underlying genetically defective lymphocytes. It also reports no changes in total circulating CD4 or CD8 cells.
